purpose: Calibrate the narrow q/r experience-integration instrument using a one-bit feedback policy and two negative controls; not an Agent experiment.
environment: Each action returns only success = (proposal == required protocol). Exactly one protocol succeeds; noiseless feedback. No governance, retry, or resource limits.
policy_inputs: Default, selected memory value, read-path availability; each update receives only own action and success. No phase, required protocol, clock, trial number, or audit trace.

policy_rules.last_feedback: Use stored protocol or default when uninitialized/blocked. After every outcome store action if successful, the other protocol if unsuccessful.
policy_rules.record_only: Always propose default; update the stored protocol after every outcome exactly as last_feedback. Never read this record for proposals.
policy_rules.freeze_first: Use stored protocol or default when uninitialized/blocked. Initialize from the first outcome, then never revise stored protocol.

probes: One proposal each from a shared checkpoint at the end of phase 1 (zero-based): latest memory, blocked read, phase-0 memory. World remains at phase 1. No probe feedback is returned and no probe updates state.
scoring: Report all continuous actions. Separately count trials 1 and 2 (zero-based) in phases 1 and 2, after first new feedback. Count probe correctness and proposal differences plus direction; all four label/default pairs are enumerated, not statistical samples.
interpretation: Expectations follow by inspection of fixed rules. Executing them checks the proposed measurements, not empirical learning, statistical significance, reflection, strong experience, responsibility, temporal priority P1 or governance causation P2.
